parent_objective: implement no-PPO active-steer guard calibration diagnostic

public_gates: M798 implements active-steer guard calibration only
M798 freezes base actor and M761 residual head
M798 trains only the small steer/brake calibrator
M798 runs separability and low-margin guard checks before closed-loop candidate claims
M798 blocks PPO and checkpoint promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train the base actor
do not train the M761 residual head
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not weaken M786 or M780 thresholds
do not tune only the single public active source
do not skip separability or source-diverse low-margin checks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether lexicographic active/source-diverse steer guard can fix M795 active-margin and selectivity failure
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: implementation diagnostic only; no PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if source-diverse low-margin rows cannot be selected
stop if deployable feature separability fails
stop if actor or residual checksum changes
fallback_plan: if corpus is blocked, design low-margin corpus refresh
if separability fails, design trajectory-time steering supervision
if active margin still fails after guard pass, audit and synthesize before another objective
if candidate appears, audit before PPO or promotion

hypothesis: A lexicographic active/source-diverse steer guard can convert M795's collision-free strong-gap near miss into a safer diagnostic candidate.
success_criteria: M798 writes run artifacts and docs
M798 confirms actor and residual head checksums unchanged
M798 reports separability metrics and low-margin guard rows
M798 classifies the result with the M797 taxonomy
failure_criteria: implementation trains actor or residual parameters
implementation omits separability or source-diverse low-margin metrics

commands.name: active_steer_guard_calibration
commands.command: implement and run no-PPO active-steer guard calibration; expected run dir runs/m798_v4_active_steer_guard_calibration

decision_rule: M798 may implement and run only a no-PPO active-steer guard calibration diagnostic. It must not train actor or residual parameters, run PPO, or promote a checkpoint.
